title: AgentStepPayload
description: One step of the agent's work, as any mode publishes it (agent.step.started, agent.step.updated, agent.step.ended; design 2026-11-07 §2). The person it is for is the envelope's subject. The payload is the step's shape: what it is, where it ran, why, how it ended, what it cost, and where to see it. It never carries the step's content: no prompt, no diff, no page, no message, no file. The three events share this payload; what differs is the envelope's event_type. The agent.* namespace belongs to the network, so any first-party mode may publish into it (like provider.*); OpenVibe.Actor registers the family and keeps the timeline.

step_id.description: The mode's own id for this step (a Codes task id, a Run job id, a stream id).

mode.description: The mode the step belongs to.

product.description: The product that ran it (chat, codes, run, watch, live, surf, actor).

ref.description: The product's own id for the thing this step is about.

title.description: A short plain-text name for the step. What it was, never what it said.

placement.description: Where the step ran and why the agent put it there, in one line each.

link.description: The step's own page in its product.

reason.description: Why it failed or stopped, in one line a person can act on.

transition.description: The agent's sentence for the mode change this step announced.

approval.description: The approval this step waits on, and the mode that owns it. The person answers it in the mode.
